scientific_scope.system: seven spatially overlapping spectral channels in one common-field sensor image
scientific_scope.current_local_model: fixed physical inverse followed by a six-stage shared CNN correction
scientific_scope.temperature_quantity: effective continuum color temperature after object blur
scientific_scope.evidence_domain: constructed synthetic measurements under frozen synthetic calibration

prospective_v4_4_development_screen.numeric_rationale: New development noninferiority tolerance borrowing the old temperature relative factor and old template absolute tolerance; not an existing signed gate or significance test.
prospective_v4_4_development_screen.signed_weak_L2_formula: sqrt(sum(template_SSE) / sum(truth_energy)) within each separate condition
descriptive_metrics_not_new_hard_thresho: energy-pooled signed projection by each condition
signed fixed 60e recall with unchanged support definition
prospective_v4_4_development_screen.residual_risk: A weak output close to zero can still achieve L2 slightly below one. Passing does not establish amplitude recovery.
prospective_v4_4_development_screen.weak_recall_caution: Nominal signed weak peak is 45e, below the fixed 60e threshold; weak recall alone is not a valid recovery gate.

intervention.name: final_continuum_anchored_signed_CNN_output
intervention.only_changed_variable: final continuum state fields [0,1] replaced by the same cached physical continuum fields
intervention.signed_output: original frozen-residual-scaled CNN signed proposal fields [2,3,4]
required_per_case_invariants: anchored continuum state equals cached physical continuum state
anchored color temperature equals physical color temperature
anchored signed template equals same-weight original residual-scaled signed template
raw, bands and validity are recomputed for the combined state
intervention.numeric_tolerance_policy: Freeze identity/replay tolerance before execution; use exact equality where identical operations permit it, otherwise report max error and the predeclared tolerance.
intervention.interpretation: Tests the consequence of a final output constraint; does not prove internal compensation absent or identify a unique causal mechanism.

finite_decision_tree.if_implementation_invalid: stop numerical interpretation and correct implementation without adding a research arm

finite_decision_tree.initial_optimizer: empty Adam, matched to residual_scaled control
finite_decision_tree.validation_each: full 776 cases plus unchanged original 16 gates; all historical and new screens

finite_decision_tree.candidate_filter: historical_acceptance AND prospective_screen AND implementation_invariants AND complete_artifact_checks
finite_decision_tree.selection_rule: minimum unchanged full-validation main loss among admitted candidates; exact ties by earlier update then fixed candidate ordering

finite_decision_tree.signed_claim_requirement: Freeze independent signed mother IDs, generation protocol and decision rules before generation/scoring, or explicitly limit final claims to the existing main suite.
finite_decision_tree.success_claim_limit: prespecified synthetic distribution and endpoints only; not measured thermometry or hardware acceptance

engineering_delivery_receipts_required: configuration checkpoint source and data-manifest hashes
